name: ChunkKdaWithFusedGateFwd

raw_g.description: Raw gate projection [B, T, H*K] (or [B, T, H, K])

initial_state.description: Initial state [B, H, K, V] (varlen: [N, H, K, V]), optional

output_final_state.description: Whether to return the final state

o.description: Output [B, T, H, V], dtype matches v

final_state.description: Final state [B, H, K, V] (varlen: [N, H, K, V]), fp32

reference:
import zlib

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def run(q, k, v, raw_g, beta, A_log, g_bias=None, scale=None,
        initial_state=None, output_final_state=False, cu_seqlens=None):
    B, T, H, K = q.shape
    V = v.shape[-1]
    if scale is None:
        scale = K ** -0.5

    rg = raw_g.float()
    if rg.dim() == 3:
        rg = rg.reshape(B, T, H, K)
    if g_bias is not None:
        rg = rg + g_bias.float().reshape(H, K)
    a = -torch.exp(A_log.float().reshape(H))
    g = a.view(1, 1, H, 1) * F.softplus(rg)

    qf = q.transpose(1, 2).float() * scale
    kf = k.transpose(1, 2).float()
    vf = v.transpose(1, 2).float()
    betaf = beta.transpose(1, 2).float()
    gf = g.transpose(1, 2)

    if cu_seqlens is not None:
        cu = cu_seqlens.cpu().tolist()
        spans = [(0, i, cu[i], cu[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cu) - 1)]
    else:
        spans = [(b, b, 0, T) for b in range(B)]

    o = torch.zeros(B, H, T, V, device=q.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    final_states = []

    for b, si, bos, eos in spans:
        h = torch.zeros(H, K, V, device=q.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        if initial_state is not None:
            h = initial_state[si].float().clone()

        for t in range(bos, eos):
            qt = qf[b, :, t]
            kt = kf[b, :, t]
            vt = vf[b, :, t]
            gt = gf[b, :, t]
            bt = betaf[b, :, t]

            h = h * gt.exp()[..., None]
            delta = vt - (h * kt[..., None]).sum(-2)
            delta = delta * bt[..., None]
            h = h + kt.unsqueeze(-1) * delta.unsqueeze(-2)
            o[b, :, t] = torch.einsum("hk,hkv->hv", qt, h)

        final_states.append(h)

    o = o.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().to(v.dtype)
    final_state = torch.stack(final_states, dim=0) if output_final_state else None
    return o, final_state


_DTYPE_CODE = {0: torch.float16, 1: torch.bfloat16, 2: torch.float32}


def make_inputs(axes, device):
    """Custom input generator (custom_inputs_entrypoint).

    Deterministic per case: RNG is reseeded from the axes dict so repeated
    calls (once per custom input) produce identical tensors. Tensors are
    generated on CPU; the evaluator moves them to the target device.

    axes:
        B, T, H, K, V   shapes of q/k [B,T,H,K], v [B,T,H,V]
        DT    dtype code for q/k/v/beta (0=fp16, 1=bf16, 2=fp32)
        DTG   dtype code for raw_g/A_log/g_bias
    """
    torch.manual_seed(zlib.crc32(repr(sorted(axes.items())).encode()) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
    B, T, H, K, V = axes["B"], axes["T"], axes["H"], axes["K"], axes["V"]
    dt = _DTYPE_CODE[axes["DT"]]
    dtg = _DTYPE_CODE[axes["DTG"]]

    def tight(shape, dtype):
        # KDA 递推对幅值极其敏感，收紧输入分布以保持长序列数值稳定
        if torch.rand(1).item() < 0.5:
            mu = float(torch.empty(1).uniform_(-0.1, 0.1).item())
            sigma = float(torch.empty(1).uniform_(0.01, 0.05).item())
            if dtype is torch.bfloat16:
                return torch.normal(mu, sigma, shape, dtype=torch.float32).to(dtype)
            return torch.normal(mu, sigma, shape, dtype=dtype)
        return torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype).uniform_(-0.1, 0.1)

    q = tight([B, T, H, K], dt)
    k = tight([B, T, H, K], dt)
    v = tight([B, T, H, V], dt)
    raw_g = tight([B, T, H * K], dtg)
    # beta 必须为正且较小，防止状态爆炸
    beta = torch.empty([B, T, H], dtype=torch.float32).uniform_(0.01, 0.1).to(dt)
    A_log = tight([H], dtg)
    g_bias = tight([H * K], dtg)
    return {"q": q, "k": k, "v": v, "raw_g": raw_g, "beta": beta,
            "A_log": A_log, "g_bias": g_bias}
description: Chunk KDA forward with fused gate computation (golden for chunk_kda_with_fused_gate_fwd). Fused gate in fp32: g = -exp(A_log) * softplus(raw_g + g_bias) (softplus beta=1, threshold=20; g <= 0). KDA recurrence in fp32: h_t = Diag(exp(g_t)) * h_{t-1}; delta_t = (v_t - h_t^T k_t) * beta_t; h_t += k_t outer delta_t; o_t = h_t^T (scale * q_t). varlen supported via cu_seqlens (B == 1). use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel belongs to the upper wrapper. Inputs are generated by make_inputs (custom_inputs_entrypoint): q/k/v/raw_g/A_log/g_bias tight mixed (mu in (-0.1,0.1), sigma in (0.01,0.05) or uniform(-0.1,0.1)), beta = uniform(0.01, 0.1).
